verdict.rationale: Cognee publishes a pricing page confirming a free/open-source tier ('free, forever') and lists cloud features like data-source integrations and code indexing, but no evidence shows concrete per-unit rates, usage-based pricing, or paid-tier price points that would let a platform-engineer project costs. Missing for 10: explicit per-unit/usage rates, paid tier pricing table, and any cost calculator or unit economics documentation.
